questions.explanation:
【试题考点】形容词辨析 + 语义呼应。

【解题思路】空格前 “strive for self-respect—to see ourselves in a positive light”（追求自尊 —— 以积极的眼光看待自己）明确核心语境，需填入与 “积极自我认知” 呼应的形容词，且与 “of” 构成搭配。选项 [C] proud（骄傲的）代入后 “be proud of who we are”（为自己感到骄傲），完美契合 “自尊、积极看待自我” 的语义，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] afraid（害怕的）为负面情绪，与 “positive light” 矛盾，排除；选项 [B] critical（批评的）侧重 “挑剔自身”，违背 “追求自尊” 的核心，排除；选项 [D] tolerant（容忍的）强调 “包容自身不足”，未体现 “积极认可自我” 的核心语义，与前文衔接不紧密，排除。

【试题考点】形容词辨析 + 语义逻辑。

【解题思路】前文指出 “任何损害自我价值感的评论或经历都会令人不适”，基于 “趋利避害” 的本能，“想要避免这些情况” 应是 “自然的” 反应。选项 [B] natural（自然的）代入后符合日常逻辑，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] risky（危险的）与 “想要避免不适” 的合理诉求相悖，排除；选项 [C] admirable（令人钦佩的）程度过重，“避免不适” 是本能反应，并非值得钦佩的品质，排除；选项 [D] foolish（愚蠢的）否定了这种合理诉求，语义不通，排除。

【试题考点】连词辨析 + 从句逻辑。

【解题思路】空格后 “your self-worth really is being undermined is, to a large degree, subjective”（你的自我价值是否真的被削弱，在很大程度上是主观的）为完整主语从句，需填入表 “是否” 的连词引导该从句。选项 [A] whether（是否）符合语法规则与语义逻辑，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [B] where（哪里）表地点，无法修饰 “自我价值被削弱” 这一抽象概念，排除；选项 [C] why（为什么）表原因，原文未探讨 “自我价值被削弱的原因”，排除；选项 [D] how（如何）表方式，与 “主观判断” 的核心语义无关，排除。

【试题考点】名词辨析 + 语义衔接。

【解题思路】前文强调 “自我价值是否被削弱是主观的”，空格后 “what someone said or did”（别人说的话或做的事）提示，这种主观性源于 “你对他人言行的理解”。选项 [C] perception（理解；认知）代入后语义通顺，符合 “主观认知决定是否感到被冒犯” 的逻辑，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] citation（引用）侧重 “引用他人言论”，与 “主观理解” 无关，排除；选项 [B] imitation（模仿）表示 “模仿他人言行”，未体现 “解读” 的核心，排除；选项 [D] introduction（介绍）侧重 “初次接触的介绍”，与上下文语义脱节，排除。

【试题考点】形容词辨析 + 语义逻辑。

【解题思路】前文 “boss picks holes in your sales report”（老板挑你的销售报告的毛病）为触发场景，空格处需填入与 “负面解读” 呼应的形容词 —— 你因此觉得自己是 “不合格的员工”。选项 [A] poor（差的；不合格的）符合这种负面联想，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [B] loyal（忠诚的）、[C] creative（有创造力的）均为积极形容词，与 “被挑毛病后的负面感受” 矛盾，排除；选项 [D] shy（害羞的）侧重性格特征，与 “工作表现” 无关，无法呼应 “销售报告被挑错” 的场景，排除。

【试题考点】形容词辨析 + 语境搭配。

【解题思路】空格后 “get-together at the pub”（酒吧聚会）与 “friends cancel”（朋友取消）提示，聚会应是 “提前计划好的”。选项 [D] planned（计划好的）代入后 “cancelling your planned get-together”（取消你们计划好的聚会）符合日常语境，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] sponsored（赞助的）侧重 “商业赞助的活动”，与 “朋友间的聚会” 不符，排除；选项 [B] crowded（拥挤的）描述聚会的状态，而非 “被取消前的属性”，排除；选项 [C] disputed（有争议的）表示 “存在分歧的聚会”，不符合朋友间聚会的常规语境，排除。

【试题考点】名词辨析 + 语义搭配。

【解题思路】后文 “personalisation”（个性化解读）是心理学中对前文所述思维方式的 “专业术语命名”，空格处需填入表 “术语” 的名词。选项 [B] term（术语）代入后 “psychologists have a term for this way of thinking”（心理学家对此种思维方式有一个术语）符合专业表达习惯，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] method（方法）侧重 “解决问题的方式”，而非 “命名某一思维模式”，排除；选项 [C] design（设计）强调 “人为规划的方案”，与 “自然形成的思维方式” 无关，排除；选项 [D] goal（目标）表示 “追求的目的”，与 “术语命名” 语义不符，排除。

【试题考点】名词辨析 + 语义转折。

【解题思路】前文描述了你对老板行为的 “负面主观解读”，后文 “your boss might view you very highly”（你的老板可能非常看重你）揭示了 “实际情况”，前后构成 “主观解读 vs 客观现实” 的转折。选项 [D] reality（现实）代入后 “but the reality is...”（但现实是……）衔接自然，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] evidence（证据）侧重 “支撑观点的依据”，原文未提及 “证明老板看重你的证据”，排除；选项 [B] theory（理论）表示 “抽象的理论”，与 “具体的老板态度” 不符，排除；选项 [C] condition（条件）强调 “前提条件”，无法体现 “主观与客观的反差”，排除。

【试题考点】名词辨析 + 语义衔接。

【解题思路】前文 “boss picks holes in your sales report”（老板挑销售报告的毛病）与后文 “point these out so that you do better next time”（指出来让你下次做得更好）提示，老板挑错的原因是你 “犯了错误”。选项 [C] mistakes（错误）代入后语义通顺，符合 “指出错误→改进提升” 的逻辑，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] complaints（抱怨）表示 “你对报告的抱怨”，与 “老板挑错” 的场景矛盾，排除；选项 [B] choices（选择）侧重 “决策层面的选择”，而非 “报告中的失误”，排除；选项 [D] suggestions（建议）表示 “你提出的建议”，老板不会 “挑建议的毛病”，语义不通，排除。

【试题考点】副词辨析 + 逻辑关系。

【解题思路】前文讲述 “老板挑错” 的例子（你误解了老板的意图），后文讲述 “朋友取消聚会” 的例子（你同样误解了朋友的意图），两个例子为 “并列同类” 关系，需填入表 “同样地” 的副词。选项 [A] Similarly（��样地）符合逻辑，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [B] Relatively（相对地）侧重 “比较之下的程度”，原文未对比两个例子，排除；选项 [C] Accordingly（因此）表因果关系，两个例子并非 “原因 - 结果” 关联，排除；选项 [D] Contrarily（相反地）表转折关系，两个例子核心逻辑一致（均为误解），排除。

【试题考点】动词辨析 + 固定搭配。

【解题思路】空格后 “their minds” 提示，朋友取消聚会的原因可能是 “改变主意”，“change one's mind” 为固定搭配，意为 “改变主意”。选项 [B] changed（改变）代入后符合语境，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] opened（打开）构成 “open one's mind”（开放思想），与 “取消聚会” 无关，排除；选项 [C] trained（训练）构成 “train one's mind”（训练思维），语义不符，排除；选项 [D] cleared（清理）构成 “clear one's mind”（理清思绪），无法解释 “取消聚会” 的行为，排除。

【试题考点】名词辨析 + 指代逻辑。

【解题思路】前文明确列举了 “老板挑错” 和 “朋友取消聚会” 两个场景，空格处需填入指代这两个场景的名词。选项 [D] examples（例子）代入后 “in both examples”（在这两个例子中）指代清晰，衔接自然，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] quotations（引用）侧重 “引用他人的话”，无法指代具体场景，排除；选项 [B] experiments（实验）表示 “有目的的科学实验”，与 “日常社交场景” 不符，排除；选项 [C] questions（问题）强调 “需要解决的疑问”，两个例子是 “误解场景” 而非 “问题”，排除。

【试题考点】名词辨析 + 语义搭配。

【解题思路】后文 “mind reading”（读心术）是与 “personalisation”（个性化解读）并列的另一种 “心理活动过程”，空格处需填入表 “过程” 的名词。选项 [A] process（过程）代入后 “another process at work”（另一种起作用的心理过程）符合语义，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [B] objective（目标）侧重 “追求的目的”，“读心术” 是无意识的心理行为，而非刻意追求的目标，排除；选项 [C] outcome（结果）表示 “最终结果”，“读心术” 是中间的心理过程，而非结果，排除；选项 [D] background（背景）强调 “背后的环境因素”，与 “心理活动本身” 无关，排除。

【试题考点】动词辨析 + 语义逻辑。

【解题思路】前文 “you assume to know what other people are thinking about you”（你假设知道别人对你的想法）提示，这种 “读心” 是主观猜测，“不直接询问他人就无法真正知道其想法”。选项 [D] asking（询问）代入后符合 “猜测 vs 实证” 的逻辑，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] blaming（责备）表示 “责备他人”，与 “了解想法” 无关，排除；选项 [B] warning（警告）表示 “警告他人”，语义不符，排除；选项 [C] teaching（教）表示 “教导他人”，无法帮助了解他人的想法，排除。

【试题考点】动词短语辨析 + 语义搭配。

【解题思路】空格后 “personalisation and mind reading”（个性化解读和读心术）是需要 “避免陷入” 的负面思维方式，选项 [C] engaging in（参与；陷入）代入后 “avoid engaging in...”（避免陷入……）符合语境，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] arguing about（争论）表示 “就…… 争论”，与 “避免这种思维方式” 无关，排除；选项 [B] accounting for（解释）表示 “为…… 解释”，无法体现 “主动陷入负面思维” 的含义，排除；选项 [D] interfering with（干扰）表示 “干扰……”，原文是 “避免自身陷入”，而非 “干扰这种思维”，语义不���，排除。

【试题考点】动词辨析 + 语义衔接。

【解题思路】空格前 “negative assumptions of what's...”（对所…… 事情的负面假设）提示，需填入表 “发生” 的动词，指代前文所述的 “老板挑错、朋友取消聚会” 等具体事件。选项 [A] happened（发生）代入后 “what's happened”（所发生的事）语义通顺，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [B] continued（继续）表示 “事情继续发生”，原文侧重 “对已发生事件的假设”，而非 “持续发生的事件”，排除；选项 [C] returned（返回）表示 “事情返回”，语义不通，排除；选项 [D] disappeared（消失）表示 “事情消失”，与 “负面假设” 的对象不符，排除。

【试题考点】形容词辨析 + 语义并列。

【解题思路】空格前 “deep or” 提示，需填入与 “deep”（深刻的）并列的形容词，修饰 “about you”（关于你的评价），且体现 “核心、本质” 的含义。选项 [D] fundamental（根本的）代入后 “deep or fundamental about you”（关于你的深刻或根本性评价）符合语义，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] casual（随意的）与 “deep” 语义相反，排除；选项 [B] obvious（明显的）侧重 “表面可见”，而非 “深层本质”，排除；选项 [C] familiar（熟悉的）强调 “熟悉度”，与 “评价的深度” 无关，排除。

【试题考点】名词辨析 + 语义呼应。

【解题思路】前文 “boss picks holes in your sales report”（老板挑销售报告的毛病）本质是 “给你反馈”，后文 “want to help you...”（想帮助你……）也呼应了反馈的目的。选项 [B] feedback（反馈）代入后 “give you feedback”（给你反馈）符合语境，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] reward（奖励）表示 “给予奖励”，与 “挑错” 的场景矛盾，排除；选项 [C] trust（信任）表示 “给予信任”，老板挑错并非 “表达信任”，语义不符，排除；选项 [D] proof（证明）表示 “提供证明”，与 “帮助你提升” 的逻辑无关，排除。

【试题考点】动词辨析 + 语义衔接。

【解题思路】前文 “point these out so that you do better next time”（指出错误让你下次做得更好）提示，老板给反馈的目的是帮你 “改进”。选项 [C] improve（改进；提升）代入后语义通顺，符合 “反馈→改进” 的逻辑，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] innovate（创新）侧重 “创造新事物”，老板的反馈是 “修正错误”，而非 “鼓励创新”，排除；选项 [B] concentrate（集中）表示 “集中注意力”，与 “反馈的目的” 无关，排除；选项 [D] relax（放松）表示 “放松身心”，语义不符，排除。

【试题考点】形容词辨析 + 语义逻辑。

【解题思路】空格前 “friends felt able to cancel at late notice”（朋友能临时取消聚会）提示，这种信任源于 “友谊牢固”—— 牢固的友谊允许临时变动，无需担心关系受损。选项 [B] strong（牢固的）代入后符合 “友谊基础好→可灵活调整” 的逻辑，故为正确选项。

【干扰排除】选项 [A] strange（奇怪的）表示 “友谊奇怪”，与 “临时取消聚会” 的信任逻辑矛盾，排除；选项 [C] vulnerable（脆弱的）表示 “友谊脆弱”，临时取消会破坏脆弱的友谊，与原文语义相反，排除；选项 [D] valuable（有价值的）侧重 “友谊的重要性”，但未体现 “关系稳固” 这一核心 —— 有价值的友谊未必允许临时取消，排除。

sections.title: 写作 Part A
sections.passage:
1 Dear Jack, 【称谓】
1 I hope this email finds you well! 【问候】 2 I’m writing to tell you how delighted I was to watch the travel video you shared. 【写信目的】 3 The stunning scenery of China — from the majestic mountains to the charming water towns — was vividly presented, and I could feel the joy and warmth of your family throughout the video. 【点题】 4 It’s truly a wonderful record of your journey! 【评价】
1 I’m quite curious to learn more about your travel experience. 【说明目的】 2 Could you share which cities you visited and if there were any special local foods or cultural activities that left a deep impression on you? 【题目要求2】 3 I’d love to hear all the interesting details.
1 Wish you all the best! 【表达祝福】
1 Yours sincerely, 【问候】
1 Li Ming 【署名】

sections.title: 写作 Part B
sections.passage:
1 What is vividly shown in the bar chart is a survey on people’s views about children’s outdoor activities, listing four key benefits. 【描述图表-宏观】 2 Specifically, “satisfying curiosity” and “promoting observation skills” take up 54.6% and 54.5% respectively, becoming the most recognized advantages. 【细节描述1】 3 By contrast, the proportions of “improving physical health” and “strengthening parent-child interaction” are relatively lower, at 37.2% and 33.2%. 【细节描述2】
1 The dominance of the first two benefits stems from the shifting educational priorities of modern parents. 【论证1】 2 In today’s society, cognitive development is highly valued: outdoor activities allow kids to explore nature, which effectively sparks their curiosity and hones their observation abilities. 【论据1】 3 By contrast, although outdoor activities do boost physical strength or enhance parent-child ties, parents tend to associate these goals with specialized sports classes (for fitness) or indoor family games (for interaction), thus regarding the two benefits as incidental rather than core values of outdoor experiences. 【论证2】
1 Undoubtedly, children’s outdoor activities offer multi-faceted value. 【总结】 2 Thus, parents should actively involve kids in outdoor experiences — this practice can nurture both mental growth and physical well-being, while deepening parent-child relationships. 【结论】

sections.title: 阅读Text1
sections.passage:
1 Ask people about public libraries and a certain image springs to mind: dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place you enjoyed as a child but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now? 2 And anyway — aren’t they all closing?
1 The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.? 2 As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald’s.
1 Enter any one of them and you will find a hive of activity. 2 While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.
1 There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs. 2 Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks, with a link to the GP’s surgery.? 3 There are libraries where young people can borrow a Fifa-standard football free.
1 In return for all of this, you’ll be asked for precisely nothing.? 2 There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it and left alone if you do not. 3 There is no other institution, public or private, that can say the same. 4 Yet still our libraries are often overlooked and underappreciated. 5 There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
1 The number of libraries that have closed since 2010 is disputed. 2 An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England. 3 It is, of course, 230 libraries too many.? 4 If we are to protect our libraries for future generations, we must raise awareness of them and the work they do.
1 The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.? 2 If we don’t use them, we will end up losing them. 3 And for those who haven’t been to a library for some time, they may be surprised by what they find.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Make a plan for their expansions.

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 commissioned to do 和 English public libraries 可定位至文章2段：The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.

第 2 段明确说明作者的委托任务：文化部门委托 “我” 对英国公共图书馆进行 “独立审查”（conduct an independent review），且审查结果已发布（published yesterday）。“independent review” 的核心含义是对事物当前状况进行全面调查与评估，而非聚焦传统、计划或意见收集。

综上可知，针对题干所问的 “作者受委托做什么”，即对应了这一“独立审查” ，即调查图书馆的当前现状。故选项 D（Look into their current situation. 调查它们的当前现状）是对委托任务的精准概括。其中 Look into 对应 conduct an independent review（审查本质是调查分析），current situation 是对审查对象（公共图书馆现状）的直接体现，故为正确选项。

由题干中的定位关键词 Para 3&4 和 the author finds, libraries可定位至文章3-4段。

文章的第 3、4 段核心围绕图书馆的功能展开：

  • 第 3 段：while books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.

第 3 段先明确 “书籍是核心”，随后转折指出图书馆提供 “大量其他服务”，并列举就业建议、语言课程、数字服务等；

  • 第 4 段：There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres... Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks... there are libraries where young people can borrow a Fifa-standard football free.

第 4 段进一步拓展服务类型，包括商业与知识产权中心、基础健康检查、免费借阅足球等。

综上可知，两段共同体现图书馆的功能不再局限于藏书借书，而是涵盖多领域的多样化服务。故选项 C（perform diversified functions. 履行多样化的功能）是对第 3、4 段核心内容的精准概括。其中 diversified functions 对应原文 a multitude of other services 及后续列举的就业、语言、健康、体育等多类服务，准确体现了图书馆功能的多样性，故为正确选项。

由题干中的定位关键词Para.5 和 libraries， should 可定位至文章第 5 段全段。

5段1-3句：强调了图书馆的独特价值 ，即其提供了丰富服务却完全免费、无门槛。

5段4句转折，指出当前困境：图书馆 “常被忽视和低估”（overlooked and underappreciated）、访问量整体下降、因地方财政压力而举步维艰。

综上可知，结合 “价值高但处境艰难” 的对比，可隐含推断出 “图书馆应得到更多关注与重视”。故选项 A（be given greater attention. 得到更多关注）是对第 5 段隐含逻辑的合理推导。原文 “overlooked and underappreciated” 直接说明图书馆缺乏足够关注，而其独特价值又值得被重视，因此 “应给予更多关注” 是必然推论，故为正确选项。

由题干中的定位关键词 statistics ，Paragraph 6 和 show 可定位至文章第 6 段1-3句。

6段2句指出一组统计数据，即：英国自 2010 年以来关闭的图书馆数量，第三方机构统计约 800 家（An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK），官方统计英格兰地区 230 家（official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England）；

6段3句中，作者明确表态指出：230 家也太多了(230 libraries too many.)。

综上可知，数据的核心指向是 “图书馆关闭数量可观”，结合前文提到的 “访问量下降、财政压力”，这些数据共同反映出图书馆面临的生存危机。故选项 A（the crisis faced by libraries. 图书馆面临的危机）是对统计数据核心意义的精准解读。数据通过 “关闭数量多” 的客观事实，直观体现了图书馆的生存困境，即 “危机”，作者的表态进一步强化了这一解读，故为正确选项。

由题干中的定位关键词  suggested，libraries ， last paragraph 可定位至文章7段1句：The review recommends（=suggested） a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.

7段1句明确给出针对图书馆的三项建议：① 全国品牌推广活动（recommends a national branding），增强实体存在感（give libraries a stronger physical presence）；② 重新推出 “全国通用借书卡” 计划（会员可在全国任何图书馆使用借书卡，the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country）；③ 儿童自动会员制（automatic memberships for children）。这三项建议的核心均是 “降低使用门槛、提升用户使用便利性”，从而吸引更多人使用图书馆。

综上可知，选项 C（Improving user convenience. 提升用户便利性）是对建议核心的精准概括。其中 “全国通用借书卡” 减少了地域限制带来的不便，“儿童自动会员制” 降低了儿童成为会员的门槛，均直接指向 “提升用户便利性”，故为正确选项。

sections.title: 阅读Text2
sections.passage:
1 According to our research, around one in five workers in the UK talk to AI like a friend, looking for guidance on personal and professional problems. 2 Our data shows that engaging with AI like this can leave us feeling heard and less isolated.? 3 But, with this newfound connection, many of us share sensitive, sometimes highly confidential information, even though over a third of people don’t realise that AI platforms may not be very good at keeping our secrets... secret.
1 For businesses, the implications are worrying. 2 Consider Microsoft Copilot for example. 3 It grants Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user — rights to use this data in any way it sees fit, it can even share it with third parties. 4 This means that any sensitive business information could potentially be exposed to the world.? 5 Employers are taking note and taking action.? 6 According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations. 7 But even with these policies in place, some employees choose to break the rules. 8 They have their reasons — around 63% of them report that using AI increases their productivity, and some even feel AI offers more help than their human colleagues.
1 The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure. 2 Employers need to manage AI tools with the same level of care as any other form of data sharing or storage. 3 There’s also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI. 4 By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.?
1 With AI’s potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it’s up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy. 2 There’s no need to back away from progress, as long as we’re equipped with the knowledge and tools to make sure AI remains a friend. 3 And this is where the challenge lies. 4 There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it’s easy to fall victim.? 5 But by building a culture of digital responsibility within our businesses, we can create a future where AI can help us without spilling the beans.

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 Paragraph 1、workers’ engagement with AI 可定位至文章第 1 段1-2句：According to our research, around one in five workers in the UK talk to AI like a friend, looking for guidance on personal and professional problems. Our data shows that engaging with AI（≈engagement with AI） like this can leave us feeling heard and less isolated.

第 1 段主要阐述了英国职场人士与 AI 互动的情况：

1段1句指出：五分之一的员工将 AI 视为朋友（one in five workers in the UK talk to AI like a friend），寻求个人和职业问题的指导（looking for guidance on personal and professional problems）；

1段2句指出：关键结论是这种互动能让人 “感觉被倾听，减少孤独感”（feeling heard and less isolated）。

综上分析，结合题干问 “员工与 AI 的互动能带来什么”，可知其能带来的是情感层面的积极影响。故选项 B（give them emotional support. 给予他们情感支持）是对原文核心信息的精准概括。其中 emotional support 直接对应 feeling heard and less isolated（被倾听、减少孤独感均属于情感层面的支持），准确捕捉了互动的核心价值，故为正确选项。

由题干中的定位关键词 Microsoft Copilot、the use of AI， may 可定位至文章第 2段2-4句。而该题考察例子所论证的和AI使���有关的论点，故需要结合段落主旨进行选择。

2段1句指出 “AI 对企业存在隐患”（the implications are worrying.），随后2句其以 Microsoft Copilot 为例佐证。

2段3句指出： Copilot 赋予微软广泛权利（It grants Microsoft broad rights），可任意使用用户输入 / 输出数据（data inputted or outputted by any users），甚至分享给第三方（even share it with third parties）

2段4句提出其后果，即：企业敏感信息可能面临风险（any sensitive business information could potentially be at risk）。

由此可知，题干中所考察的例子的核心作用是具象化 “AI 使用对企业的威胁”。选项 A（pose a threat to businesses. 对企业构成威胁）是对例子核心作用的精准匹配。其中 pose a threat 对应 sensitive business information could potentially be at risk（敏感商业信息有风险），例子通过具体产品的权限设置，直观体现了 AI 对企业的潜在威胁，故为正确选项。

choices.label: C
choices.text: its significant role in their work

choices.label: D
choices.text: the need to compete with others

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 some employees，choose to break the rules ， AI、due to 可定位至文章第 2 段5句：But even with these policies in place, some employees chose AI because it increases their productivity, and some even feel AI offers more help than their human colleagues.

3段4句提到： “25% 的企业禁止或规范 AI 使用”（25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organizations）

3段5句转折，指出即使有政策出台（But even with these policies in place），仍有部分员工仍违反规定使用 AI（some employees chose AI），核心原因是：① AI 能提高工作效率（increases their productivity）；② 比人类同事提供更多帮助（offers more help than their human colleagues）。

综上可知，员工依旧使用AI的原因有二，且二者共同指向 AI 在工作中的重要作用。故选项 C（its significant role in their work. 其在工作中的重要作用）是对原因的精准概括。其中 significant role 对应 increases their productivity 和 offers more help than human colleagues，准确体现了员工违反规定的核心动因 ——AI 对工作的重要价值，故为正确选项。

choices.label: A
choices.text: increase the transparency of their data sources

choices.label: B
choices.text: prioritise the quality of AI-produced content

choices.label: C
choices.text: include employee perspectives in their rules

choices.label: D
choices.text: adjust their management to AI development

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 positively shift the AI landscape、businesses should 可定位至文章第 3 段4句：By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.

3段4句指出企业应对 AI 的策略：由于前文指出 AI 使用需平衡 “效率提升” 与 “数据安全”，且存在 “知识缺口”（员工不确定 AI 生成内容的所有权），故在此给出解决方案 ——“向员工灌输 AI 使用的最佳实践（instilling best practices in AI engagement），并制定随技术发展而演变的政策”（creating policies that evolve with the technology）。

综上分析可知，企业应对人工智能的格局时，应该调整其管理方式，故选项 D（adjust their management to AI development. 调整管理以适应 AI 发展）是对解决方案的精准概括。其中 adjust their management 对应 creating policies that evolve with the technology（制定随技术演变的政策），体现了企业需根据 AI 技术发展动态调整管理策略，故为正确选项。

choices.label: A
choices.text: have a limited understanding of it

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 last paragraph、easily fall victim to AI可定位至4段2-4句：There are so many products out there being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.

定位区间的核心逻辑如下：

4段2句—前提 ：只要具备足够知识和工具，AI 就能成为朋友（as long as we are equipped with the knowledge and tools to make sure AI remains a friend.）

4段3句—关键转折 ：挑战就在于这里（this is where the challenge lies），即 “人们缺乏相关知识和工具”。

4段4句—具体场景：大量 AI 产品通过广告推广（so many products out there being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets），人们容易受害（that is easy to fall victim）。

综上可知，结合前文3段提到的 “40% 的人不确定 AI 生成内容的所有权”（知识缺口），可推断 “容易受害” 的核心原因是 “对 AI 的了解有限”。故选项 A（have a limited understanding of it. 对其了解有限）是对原文逻辑的合理推导。其中 limited understanding 对应前文的 knowledge gap（知识缺口）和 “缺乏确保 AI 成为朋友的知识”，正是因为了解不足，才容易在大量广告推广的 AI 产品面前受害，故为正确选项。

sections.title: 阅读Text3
sections.passage:
1 Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike. 2 Fast trains can cover the 500km between the two cities in three hours. 3 The network also connects Naples, Bologna, Florence and Turin. 4 In many cases, it is the best option — in terms of travel time and cost — for both leisure and business travellers.
1 This is why the recent severe delays caused by numerous maintenance works have thrown the rail industry into chaos at a time when most people head on holiday, which matters for business in a country where tourism accounts for 10 per cent of GDP.?
1 Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.? 2 Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane, the publicly controlled group that owns train operator Trenitalia and the national train network RFI, said 23 percent of all high-speed trains it operated were late in 2023.
1 The huge improvements in Italy’s obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie. 2 RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026. 3 Ferrovie will invest a total of €124bn in infrastructure over the next 10 years.
1 But lack of capacity is another problem. 2 Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable. 3 “We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there’s a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex,” he said.? 4 A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities. 5 If there’s congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.?
1 One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
1 Improvements will also come from high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts. 2 It will allow for a reduction of the distance between high-speed trains travelling on the same line at any given time, which should mean a significant increase in capacity and traffic fluidity, according to Giuricin.?

choices.label: A
choices.text: is seen by tourists as outdated

choices.label: B
choices.text: is a popular option for travelling

choices.label: D
choices.text: is an example of good maintenance

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 first two paragraphs 和 high-speed rail network in Italy 可定位至文章第 1、2 段：

第 1 段核心阐述意大利高铁的核心优势与受欢迎程度：① 2008 年罗马 - 米兰高铁开通后，成为当地人和游客的 “首选出行方式”；② 覆盖多个核心城市，在旅行时间和成本上对休闲和商务旅客均为 “最佳选择”。

第 2 段虽提及近期因维护工程导致的延误，但仅为转折性补充，前两段的核心基调是 “高铁是受欢迎的出行选择”。

综上可知，意大利高铁的特点就是其是受欢迎的出行选择。故选项 B（is a popular option for travelling. 是受欢迎的旅行选择）是对首两段核心信息的精准概括。其中 popular option 对应原文 preferred means of travel 和 the best option，直接体现了高铁在当地人和游客中的受欢迎程度，故为正确选项。

choices.label: A
choices.text: the common occurrence of train delays

choices.label: B
choices.text: the value of the Italian train network

choices.label: C
choices.text: the wide media coverage of trains

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 Ferrovie、 Paragraph 3 可定位至文章第 3 段2句，由于该题目考察的是引用人物观点的目的，故要重点阅读定位句及其上下句，寻找引用句所论证的论点。

3段1句提出核心观点，即：高铁中断越来越频繁（Disruptions have become increasingly frequent），晚点已成为意大利媒体报道的常客（train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.）

3段2句随后引用 Ferrovie 的官方数据（2023 年 23% 的高铁晚点）为该观点提供客观佐证。

综上可知，第 3 段引用 Ferrovie 的话是为了通过具体数据证明 其“晚点频繁”。故选项 A（the common occurrence of train delays. 火车晚点的频繁发生）是对引用目的的精准匹配。其中 common occurrence 对应 increasingly frequent 和 a fixture in Italian media coverage，Ferrovie 的 23% 晚点数据直接印证了 “晚点频繁” 这一核心观点，故为正确选项。

由题干中的定位关键词cause of the disruptions，the network 可定位至4段1句：The huge improvements in Italy's obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie.

4段1句指出：意大利陈旧基础设施的巨大改善（The huge improvements in Italy's obsolete infrastructure）在一定程度上解释了此次中断的原因（explained the disruption）。但选项中并无与之对应的选项，故需要继续阅读下文。

5段1句指出另一个问题的原因，即运力不足（But lack of capacity is another problem）.

5段2-3句为经济学家的进一步解释：混合系统导致 “无备用容量”（there is no spare capacity），一旦线路出现小问题（ as soon as there’s a hiccup on the line），整体情况就会变得复杂（the situation becomes highly complex），最终引发中断。

综上可知，网络中断的一个原因是基础设施的盖申，二是运力不足，容量有限，故选项 C（Its limited capacity. 其有限的容量）是对原文二原因的直接匹配。其中 limited capacity 是原文 lack of capacity 和 no spare capacity 的同义替换，故为正确选项。

choices.label: A
choices.text: provides a wide choice of routes

choices.label: C
choices.text: increases the level of travel comfort

choices.label: D
choices.text: puts the high-speed network in trouble

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 mixed system 可定位至文章第 5 段4句：A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities. If there’s congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.

5段4-5句指出混合系统的运作模式及其弊端：高铁在特定路线或穿越大城市时必须行驶在普通轨道上（high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes）；导致一旦普通轨道出现拥堵或当地火车故障（If there’s congestion or,.., a local train breaks down），“整个高铁网络都会受到影响”（the entire high-speed network is affected）。

综上可知，这种混合体系会给高铁网络带来影响，故选项 D（puts the high-speed network in trouble. 给高铁网络带来麻烦）是对混合系统弊端的精准概括。其中 puts...in trouble 对应 the entire high-speed network is affected（整个高铁网络受影响），准确体现了混合系统导致高铁网络易受普通轨道问题牵连的核心弊端，故为正确选项。

choices.label: C
choices.text: building more stations in urban centres

choices.label: D
choices.text: enhancing the safety of high-speed trains

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 Improvements to the Italian train network 可定位至7段1句：Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts.

7段1句通过专家观点指出：改进（Improvements）还将来自意大利铁路网（RFI）多年来一直投入的（hat RFI has been investing in for years）高密度技术和卫星信号系统（will also come from the high-density technology and satellite）。

7段2句进一步指出这些投入的效果，即：通过高密度技术和卫星信号，能够减少同一线路上高铁之间的距离（allow for a reduction of the distance），从而提升容量和通行流畅度（a significant increase in capacity and traffic fluidity）

综上可知，意大利铁路网的改进将包括减少同一线路上高铁之间的距离，故选项 B（shortening high-speed train intervals. 缩短高铁列车的间隔）是对第 7 段改进措施的精准概括。其中 shortening...intervals 对应 reduction of the distance between high-speed trains（减少高铁之间的距离），即列车间隔缩短，故为正确选项。

sections.title: 阅读Text4
sections.passage:
1 In 2023, Chicago lost one of its most beloved street festivals. 2 The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024. 3 What began as a small neighborhood gathering blossomed into a massive cultural event, welcoming tens of thousands of people each year over nearly two decades before abruptly shutting down.?
1 Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons the Silver Room Block Party could not continue, highlighting a reality that all street festival organizers face right now.? 2 The cost of producing a street festival in Chicago has skyrocketed. 3 Security, entertainment, portable restrooms, insurance and even basics such as fencing and staffing have all become significantly more expensive. 4 At the same time, donations at festival gates have dropped dramatically.
1 Chicago’s summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they’re in and the city of Chicago as a whole. 2 Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses and foster the kind of cultural vibrancy that makes our city special.
1 We often hear people ask why we solicit donations at our entry points, especially when the city’s largest festivals like the Chicago Jazz Festival do not request donations. 2 The fact is, unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations to cover their costs.?
1 Wicker Park Fest has long been one of Chicago’s most anticipated summer festivals, drawing upward of 70,000 attendees for a full weekend of live indie music, local art, small business vendors and, most importantly, community connection. 2 In 2024, Wicker Park Fest saw record-breaking attendance. 3 Despite the turnout, gate donations reached their lowest point in our history. 4 This year, we’ve been forced to scale back the footprint of the fest. 5 We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park’s unique spirit and reputation as festival-goers have come to expect.?
1 This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you’ll remember that they exist because of community support. 2 A thriving summer festival season doesn’t happen by accident; it happens when we all chip in.?

choices.label: A
choices.text: has been replaced by other festivals

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 Paragraph 1 和 Silver Room Block Party 可定位至文章第 1 段2句：The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024.

1段2句提出Silver Room Block Party在2024年不会回归（it would not return in 2024）。

1段3句进一步介绍了Silver Room Block Party的发展与停办：① 起源是小型社区聚会（began as a small neighborhood gathering），后发展为 “大型文化活动”（blossomed into a massive cultural event）；② 近二十年来每年吸引数万人参与（welcoming tens of thousands of people each year）；③ 2024 年突然停办（abruptly shutting down）。

综上分析可知，the Silver Room Block Party本质上是一个文化活动，故选项 D（was an appealing cultural gathering. 是有吸引力的文化聚会）是对原文核心信息的精准概括。其中 appealing 对应 welcoming tens of thousands of people（吸引数万人），cultural gathering 对应 massive cultural event（大型文化活动），准确体现了该活动的核心特质，故为正确选项。

choices.label: A
choices.text: they are unable to use the donations wisely.

choices.label: B
choices.text: they are unable to get sufficient facilities.

choices.label: C

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 reality street festival organizers ，face可定位至2段1句：Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons the Silver Room Block Party could not continue, highlighting a reality that all street festival organizers face right now.

2段1句指出所有街头节日组织者面临的共同现实：① 核心原因是 “制作成本上升”（rising production costs）和 “参与者捐赠下降”（declining attendee donations）；② 随后具体列举成本上涨的领域（安保、娱乐、移动厕所等），进一步印证财务压力。

综上可知，选项 C（they have to tackle financial difficulties. 他们不得不应对财务困难）是对原文提到的现实的精准概括。其中 financial difficulties 直接对应 rising production costs 和 declining donations 带来的财务压力，是所有组织者共同面临的核心问题，故为正确选项。

choices.label: D
choices.text: are famous for their music shows

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 Paragraphs 3 and 4 和 Chicago's street festivals 可定位至文章第 3、4 段：

第 3、4 段核心阐述芝加哥街头节日的属性与资金来源：

  • 第 3 段：Chicago’s summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they’re in and the city of Chicago as whole. Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses...

第 3 段强调其核心价值 —— 不仅是娱乐，更是 “经济引擎”，直接造福社区和城市，带动当地商业客流；

  • 第 4 段：unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding...

第 4 段补充资金来源 —— 无城市资助，依赖赞助、摊位费和门票捐赠。

综上可知，芝加哥的街头节日能促进当地经济发展，故选项 C（contribute to the local economy. 促进当地经济发展）是对第 3 段核心价值的精准概括。其中 contribute to the local economy 对应 economic engines 和 drive foot traffic to local businesses，准确体现了街头节日对当地经济的积极作用，故为正确选项。

choices.label: C
choices.text: give up its most prominent feature.

questions.explanation:
由题干中的定位关键词 organizers of Wicker Park Fest have to 可定位至文章第 5 段：We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs...

第 5 段核心阐述 Wicker Park Fest 的困境与应对措施：① 困境 ——2024 年参与人数创纪录，但门票捐赠达历史最低；② 应对措施 —— 缩小活动规模、取消一个舞台、减少表演者数量、额外削减成本，同时努力保持活动活力。题干问 “可推断组织者不得不做什么”，核心对应其具体应对措施。

综上可知，选项 B（reduce the number of performances. 减少表演数量）是对原文措施的合理推断。其中 reduce the number of performances 对应 eliminating a stage 和 booking fewer performers（取消舞台、减少表演者数量），直接体现了表演相关的削减，故为正确选项。

由题干中的定位关键词  future of street festivals depends on 可定位至6段1句：This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you’ll remember that they exist because of community support. A thriving summer festival season doesn’t happen by accident; it happens when we all chip in.

最后一段为作者的核心观点总结：① 街头节日的存在依赖 “社区支持”（community support）；② 繁荣的节日季并非偶然，而是 “所有人共同出力”（we all chip in）的结果。结合前文提到的 “捐赠下降导致活动缩减”，可推断 “社区支持” 的核心体现是参与者的捐赠，即 “参与者的慷慨”。

综上可知，选项 B（the generosity of attendees. 参与者的慷慨）是对作者核心观点的精准推导。其中 generosity of attendees 对应 community support 和 chip in，结合前文 “捐赠下降是活动停办 / 缩减的核心原因”，可知参与者的捐赠（慷��）是街头节日未来存续的关键，故为正确选项。

sections.passage:
1 In an effort to support restoration programmes, specialists are developing supplies of seeds and seedlings, maintaining gene banks and sequencing the genomes of indigenous trees and other crops. 2 Their work deals with one of the problems that could block major restoration efforts in different parts of the world.?
1 “Where’s the planting material going to come from?? 2 That’s one big bottleneck,” says genetic-resources specialist Ramni Jamnadass.
1 Asia is arguably the region most neglected by global efforts to increase diversity in restoration and to study native species. 2 Christopher Kettle, Biodiversity International’s director for forest genetic resources and restoration in Rome, says that the need for infrastructure — things such as mechanisms for collecting and storing seeds, and nurseries to raise seedlings — might be most desperate here because many trees are “masting” species, which don’t produce seeds every year.? 3 People need to be ready. 4 “Otherwise, you miss the boat, you lose all the seed and you’ve got to wait another seven years,” says Kettle. 5 “This is a really, really critical issue for restoration in Southeast Asia, because many of the most important timber species and tree species — the ones that will lock up the most carbon — they’re all masting species.”?
1 Climate change is a driving factor in the push to restore forests, but it also raises questions, such as where trees can thrive in the future. 2 Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects, diseases and other forest species. 3 “Insects that today are a minor problem may become a major problem if they can produce three or four generations in a year,” says forest ecologist John Stanturf.? 4 This remains a significant knowledge gap. 5 “We know enough to know that this is a concern, but we don’t know enough about how to respond to it yet. 6 That’s a great area to be doing research.” 7 So is soil, says Cindy Prescott, a forest ecologist at the University of British Columbia in Vancouver. 8 “If you don’t look at the soil at the start, you can spend a lot of money and time putting in species that aren’t going to survive there.”
1 With so much research left to do, leaders in the field have been doing some soul-searching, and acknowledging that restoration can be motivated by — and designed to meet — different needs. 2 “When you talk about conservation or restoration, the first question has to be restoration by whom, for whom?” says Daniel Janzen, a biologist at the University of Pennsylvania.
1 The question can have more than one answer. 2 Much of the global funding for restoration is dedicated to developing it as a tool to mitigate climate change, notes restoration ecologist Pedro Brancalion. 3 “But if you ask a farmer in Brazil if he or she is concerned about climate change, they would say, ‘No, I am concerned about water,’” he says. 4 Their interests as stewards of the land need to be better integrated with those who have the money to support restoration.
1 That has been the strongest lesson of all for Robin Chazdon, a forest ecologist at the University of Connecticut. 2 Restoration is about more than what gets planted in the ground, she says. 3 “Yes, it’s about forests, but it’s really about people. 4 They are the agents of restoration.”
